tools_problematic.problem: Reported '[PASS] Residue grep — 0 UWP-only API references' (log line 3504) even though Scenario4_OrientationChanged.xaml.cs line 49 still calls DisplayInformation.GetForCurrentView(). The residue grep only loads inventory 'unsupported' + 'residueOnly' patterns (Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 lines 69-70); 'adaptable' patterns such as GetForCurrentView() are never enforced, so a leftover call to an adaptable API passes.
tools_problematic.evidence: Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 lines 67-70 vs unsupported-api-inventory.json line 16 (GetForCurrentView is in 'adaptable').

tools_problematic.problem: Its plain 'dotnet build' reported '0 WUI analyzer warning(s)' (log line 3521) because the scaffold build does not reference Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK.Analyzers; the analyzer is only injected by the benchmark's separate 'winapp build', which DID flag WUI0004 (build-output.txt line 24). So the validator gives a false PASS on real WUI residue.
tools_problematic.evidence: build-output.txt line 24 'warning WUI0004: DisplayInformation.GetForCurrentView() is UWP-only' vs Validate log line 3521 '0 WUI analyzer warning(s)'.

tool_limitations.limitation: Neither the residue grep nor the build healthcheck catches a leftover *.GetForCurrentView() call that was silenced with try/catch rather than replaced.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Add a residueOnly pattern for '\.GetForCurrentView\s*\(' so the residue grep fails on any leftover singleton-accessor call in non-deferred files.

failed_apis.api: DisplayInformation.GetForCurrentView() (orientation members: CurrentOrientation, OrientationChanged, ReadingTransform alignment, AutoRotationPreferences)
failed_apis.why_tried: Scenario4 aligns accelerometer ReadingTransform to display orientation and subscribes to OrientationChanged.
failed_apis.root_cause: getforcurrentview pattern table maps DisplayInformation.GetForCurrentView() ONLY to a DPI replacement (XamlRoot.RasterizationScale / GetDpiForWindow); it gives no path for the orientation members, so the agent had nothing to apply and kept the UWP call wrapped in try/catch.
failed_apis.fix: Do not silence the call; apply the correct per-member replacement, or if the specific member has no supported desktop equivalent, degrade visibly (do not swallow) — see improvement-plan.json.

doc_errors.where: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md 'WUI analyzer warnings' table, WUI0004 row (line 515)
doc_errors.wrong: Symptom fixed to 'SystemNavigationManager.GetForCurrentView() is UWP-only' and fix 'Drop the system back button hookup'.
doc_errors.correct: WUI0004 fires for ANY *.GetForCurrentView() UWP singleton (DisplayInformation, UIViewSettings, ApplicationView, ResourceContext, SystemNavigationManager, ...). Route to the 'GetForCurrentView Replacements' section; back-button advice only applies to the SystemNavigationManager variant.

That covers DPI members only. DisplayInformation also exposes orientation (CurrentOrientation / OrientationChanged / AutoRotationPreferences), which has no per-view singleton on WinUI 3 desktop and needs separate handling — not a DPI call.

special_apis.api: Windows.Devices.Sensors.Accelerometer when the WinUI project namespace is also 'Accelerometer'
special_apis.special_handling: CS0118 ('Accelerometer is a namespace but is used like a type') on every field/parameter of that type. Resolve with a using alias, e.g. 'using SensorAccelerometer = Windows.Devices.Sensors.Accelerometer;' (seen in Scenario4 line 7). Recurs for every device/sensor SDK sample whose project is named after the API type (Compass, Gyrometer, Barometer, ProximitySensor, ...).
